Rishi / Ben —

Quick legal/finance notes ahead of the 10:00 call:

1) 30-day carveout: Legal can accept a conditional 30-day carveout for the activation tranche if the Order Form appendix includes (a) ACH confirmation within 5 business days of invoice, and (b) a soft-credit check clause limited to activation amount. We will document the exact fallback if ACH fails (standard net-45 revert).

2) Pricing bands: the band definitions in the XLS look good. We need to ensure the Order Form explicitly calls out whether banding is calendar-quarter based or rolling 12 months (TerraHealth to confirm preference).

3) Tax evidence: attach the Tax_Evidence_Request.pdf (template). For US customers we need W-9 or equivalent; for EU entities, a VAT registration snapshot + local certificate if reverse-charge applies. If TerraHealth expects Redwood to gross-up, flag that in the invoice appendix.

4) Invoicing cadence & PO mapping: Ben, please confirm who from Redwood Ops will be the PO recipient in the invoice metadata (email + remit entity).

I also put a placeholder DocuSign envelope (internal draft) so we can iterate on the redline.
